audit_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2H-B - Scientific Evaluation Protocol Audit & Statistical Sensitivity Register
audit_metadata.auditor_role: Independent Quantitative Methodology Auditor & Statistical Reviewer

comparators.baseline_E0: Production baseline agent (frozen commit b283ded200, hash 46e68dc93fdfb10f1eecfa832673ac4626c1b93627272d89b0d06a054cb13ffd)
comparators.candidate_D2: 50% Defensive Cash Cushion comparator (frozen raw hash 5a04215a909664681a4378ef3d06d7c33f6afc5ed1306bfe42ed37c2518f8215)

primary_endpoint.name: Paired Defensive Downside Shortfall Reduction
primary_endpoint.shortfall_metric: Delta S_t = S(R_E0,t) - S(R_D2,t), where S(R) = max(0, -R)
primary_endpoint.causal_timestamping: I_def,t is determined strictly at day t-1 close (16:00 ET) when D2 signals defensive cash allocation (w_cash = 0.50). Execution occurs at day t open (09:30 ET). Return R_t is computed from session t open to close or close to close.

statistical_hypotheses.null_hypothesis_H0: theta_def <= 0 (D2 provides no downside shortfall reduction during defensive sessions)
statistical_hypotheses.alternative_hypothesis_H1: theta_def > 0 (D2 statistically significantly reduces downside shortfall)
statistical_hypotheses.test_type: One-sided paired test with Newey-West HAC standard error and stationary block bootstrap

sixteen_point_methodological_audit.01_paired_return_definition: VERIFIED: Delta S_t strictly penalizes downside losses. Positive return days yield S(R) = 0 for both.
sixteen_point_methodological_audit.02_defensive_session_timestamp: VERIFIED: Causal indicator computed at t-1 close, eliminating lookahead bias.
sixteen_point_methodological_audit.03_fixed_hypothesis_preregistration: VERIFIED: Hypotheses and endpoints fixed prior to any prospective observation collection.
sixteen_point_methodological_audit.04_serial_dependence_and_clustering: AUDITED: Downside market shocks cluster in regimes (volatility clustering). Observations are not i.i.d.
sixteen_point_methodological_audit.05_hac_lag_selection: AUDITED: Newey-West lag bandwidth L = ceil(4 * (N / 100)^(2/9)). For N = 30 to 60, L = 3 to 4 lags.
sixteen_point_methodological_audit.06_bootstrap_block_size: AUDITED: Stationary block bootstrap with mean block length B = ceil(N^(1/3)) ~ 3 to 4 days.
sixteen_point_methodological_audit.07_minimum_detectable_effect: CALCULATED: Under sigma_DeltaS = 80 bps/day and HAC inflation VIF = 1.25, MDE = 45.4 bps/day for N = 30, and 32.1 bps/day for N = 60 at 80% power.
sixteen_point_methodological_audit.08_statistical_power_under_realistic_var: CALCULATED: For a realistic true effect of Delta S = 20 bps/day, power at N = 30 is ~35%. Power reaches 80% only if true effect >= 45.4 bps/day or sample size expands to N >= 100.
sixteen_point_methodological_audit.09_sufficiency_of_30_defensive_sessions: FINDING: 30 sessions is an asymptotic minimum floor for central limit theorem validity, but provides low power for subtle effects. Extension to N >= 45 is recommended if volatility is subdued.
sixteen_point_methodological_audit.10_adequacy_of_252_session_horizon: AUDITED: 252 trading sessions typically contain 35-85 defensive days in average markets. However, in a strong bull market, defensive days may fall below 30, requiring a contingent horizon extension.
sixteen_point_methodological_audit.11_economic_justification_of_200bps_cagr: FINDING: Secondary criterion (D2 CAGR >= E0 CAGR - 2.0%) is an economic insurance premium budget constraint, not a statistically separable hypothesis, because annual return tracking error (300-500 bps) exceeds 200 bps.
sixteen_point_methodological_audit.12_multiple_interim_looks_control: AUDITED: Formal hypothesis testing must occur only at final sample completion. Interim looks are strictly restricted to risk-stopping gates, preventing alpha-spending inflation.
sixteen_point_methodological_audit.13_missing_data_and_corporate_actions: AUDITED: Missing bars result in zero rebalance for that asset; splits/dividends adjusted using ex-date open prices.
sixteen_point_methodological_audit.14_treatment_of_zero_downside_returns: AUDITED: Up days during defensive mode produce Delta S = 0, correctly penalizing false alarms as zero shortfall savings.
sixteen_point_methodological_audit.15_early_stopping_and_risk_triggers: AUDITED: Hard-stop triggered if D2 underperforms E0 cumulative drawdown by > 300 bps or single-day residual > $0.01.
sixteen_point_methodological_audit.16_inconclusive_result_reporting: AUDITED: Results with p in [0.05, 0.20] or N_def < 30 are designated INCONCLUSIVE; no automatic promotion allowed.

historical_selection_bias_disclosure.haircut_implication: Historical t-statistics suffer from selection bias (Harvey-Liu-Zhu 2016). Prospective forward evaluation with zero parameter tuning is mathematically required to confirm efficacy.
